instructions: Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it until tender and the water is absorbed.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and cook in a covered skillet until the center reaches 165°F.
Warm the beans and corn together, stirring until hot.
Divide quinoa among four containers and top with chicken, bean-corn mixture, and salsa.
finishedWeightMethod: Estimated from each entered mass/volume using recorded cooking-yield factors: dry rice/quinoa 3.0, dry lentils/pasta 2.5, raw meat/fish 0.75, moisture-losing produce/tofu/eggs 0.9, and other ingredients 1.0. Used only for the Low Calorie badge.
